summary: Frontend verification of the FrameXTV DUB hint and stream-mode regressions completed. Classroom of the Elite opens, DUB selects Archer with controls/autoplay query parameters, and the honest availability hint is visible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified fresh Classroom player has no hint; DUB selects server=archer and shows dub-hint; SUB selects barbarian and removes hint; manual Archer selection clears hint; subtitle ON/OFF menus close; 390px overflow check passed. One persistence rerun was not completed because the test reused a stale result locator after closing the search overlay; no app failure observed.
rca of the issue: No product defect reproduced. The reported missing English dub is provider/source-stream dependent; the UI now communicates this and exposes the native player's Audio menu guidance.
